verdict.rationale: Factory offers app.factory.ai with cloud session sync and 'Droid Computers' explicitly described as 'nothing to install,' plus an API for creating/driving sessions, indicating a managed cloud path to run agents without self-hosting backend infra. However, the evidence doesn't detail underlying infrastructure guarantees (scaling, isolation, pricing tiers) typical of a fully-fledged managed cloud offering. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the cloud runtime's scalability and infrastructure management, detailed API/infra docs (openapi probe returned 404s), and clarity on multi-tenant isolation or resource limits.
